author: Athima Chansanchai, Writer
description:
XBOX Player Voice is a new place for the gaming community to share and track their feedback and get a clearer sense of how that input is shaping XBOX’s future.

Teams will review and organize the feedback and, in some cases, ideas will move forward

The post XBOX Player Voice: A simpler way to share feedback appeared first on Windows Blog.
title: XBOX Player Voice: A simpler way to share feedback
